rows.culsma_evidence: RNAtoQPCRGeneExpression passes treated_cells and reference_cells through PurifyRNAGroup to two ColumnPurifyRNA calls; each input_cells is used for aspiration, washing, lysis, and lysate transfer.
Each ColumnPurifyRNA call creates a uniquely labeled lysate and later loads it with binding buffer onto its silica column.
Each ColumnPurifyRNA call keeps its column object and column.contents through washing, on-column digestion, and elution; these are scoped instances of the same local binding.
Each purified_rna result is returned through rna_group and bound as treated_rna or reference_rna before reverse transcription.
Each cDNA reaction is held through the thermal stages and then loaded into its assigned qPCR well groups.
all_qpcr_wells is used for plate loading, cycling fluorescence, melt-curve processing, and the final structured qPCR readout.

description: Named program objects are listed when they are introduced in one source step and referenced in later source steps on the completed runtime path.
